subject: Differing number of rows between output of get.methylDiff() and getAssociationWithTSS()

messages.author: 82b8db4b61b9ebe9
messages.subject: Differing number of rows between output of get.methylDiff() and getAssociationWithTSS()
parts:
Hi,

Could I please get some advice. I am working on RRBS data. I am trying to annotate differentially methylated cytosines and regions using the following commands:

>mydiff.bases <- calculateDiffMeth(MethObj.bases)
>mydiff.bases.10 <- get.methylDiff(mydiff.bases, difference = 10, qvalue = 0.05) #require techinical replicates for validation
>mydiff.regions <- calculateDiffMeth(MethObj.regions)
>mydiff.regions.10 <- get.methylDiff(mydiff.regions, difference = 1, qvalue = 0.05) #require techinical replicates for validation

#genomic annotation_output
>UCSC_IDs <- read.transcript.features('F:/Miscellaneous/mm9_hgTables.txt', remove.unsual = TRUE, up.flank = 2000, down.flank = 0, unique.prom = FALSE)
mydiff.bases.10.annotated <- annotate.WithGenicParts(mydiff.bases.10, UCSC_IDs)

output:

  - in 'x': chrY

>mydiff.regions.10.annotated <- annotate.WithGenicParts(mydiff.regions.10, UCSC_IDs) #No problem

> DMC.annotation <- cbind(mydiff.bases.10, getAssociationWithTSS(mydiff.bases.10.annotated ))

Error in data.frame(..., check.names = FALSE) : 
  arguments imply differing number of rows: 1112, 1111
> DMR.annotation <- cbind (mydiff.regions.10, getAssociationWithTSS(mydiff.regions.10.annotated))

Error in data.frame(..., check.names = FALSE) : 
  arguments imply differing number of rows: 8041, 8011

I am unsure what is causing the problem with differing number of rows between  get.methylDiff() output and getAssociationWithTSS() output.

Could I please get some advice on resolving this issue?

Thanks very much!

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Differing number of rows between output of get.methylDiff() and getAssociationWithTSS()
parts:
This could be due to the fact that some chromosomes are dropped at some point and you have no longer CpGs assoctiated with TSSes for those chromosomes. Warning messages indicate that. 

getAssociationWithTSS() returns a data frame containing row number of the target features,
distance of target to nearest TSS, TSS/Gene name, TSS strand. This means you can subset
mydiff.bases.10 based on the row numbers column of getAssociationWithTSS()  and then use cbind().

Best,
Altuna
